title: Grateful Dead Live at County Fairgrounds on 1968-05-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent early‑day sound captured by Jorma with solid instrument mix, though vocals are weak and track splits are annoying.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crisp, classic‑era instrumentation that many fans consider a must‑download, but the vocal mix—especially Pigpen’s singing—is notably thin. Aside from unnecessary track separations, the audio quality is good overall, making it an enjoyable listen for those who appreciate early Dead performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistent reviews (5‑star, 4‑star, 5‑star) praise the instrument capture and overall sound while noting minor vocal issues; the weighted average of show (limited data) and recording quality yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Instrumental mix is clear and well‑balanced; vocals are thin/muffled. Some listeners dislike the artificial track separations, but no major dropouts or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure were provided.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's vocal presence is poorly captured in the mix.
